panel-frame.use: GamePanel / modal frame (border-image, stretch; hollow centre shows the dark-metal tile)

hud-frame.use: Thin HUD plate frame for clock / health block (border-image, stretch)

btn-primary.use: GameButton primary face: border-image slice 0 66 0 66 (horizontal only), height fixed 80px; hover/pressed via filter brightness

btn-secondary.use: GameButton secondary face: border-image slice 0 66 0 66 (horizontal only), height fixed 80px; hover/pressed via filter brightness

btn-disabled.use: GameButton disabled face: border-image slice 0 66 0 66 (horizontal only), height fixed 80px; hover/pressed via filter brightness

btn-danger.use: GameButton danger face: border-image slice 0 66 0 66 (horizontal only), height fixed 80px; hover/pressed via filter brightness

bar-hp.use: GameBar shell (bar-hp); caps via border-image slice 0 73 0 73; put fill element inside channel rect

bar-xp.use: GameBar shell (bar-xp); caps via border-image slice 0 63 0 63; put fill element inside channel rect

bar-drive.use: GameBar shell (bar-drive); caps via border-image slice 0 67 0 67; put fill element inside channel rect

boss-warden.use: Boss bar plate (boss-warden); emblem sits in socket; fill in channel; slice 0 122 0 151

boss-seraph.use: Boss bar plate (boss-seraph); emblem sits in socket; fill in channel; slice 0 136 0 151

slot-frame.use: Ability slot frame (fixed size ~ 2x of 46u). Inner hollow rect in manifest

crest-base.use: Form crest medallion (HUD portrait corner, hero select, form readiness)

crest-f1.use: Form crest medallion (HUD portrait corner, hero select, form readiness)

crest-f2.use: Form crest medallion (HUD portrait corner, hero select, form readiness)

crest-f3.use: Form crest medallion (HUD portrait corner, hero select, form readiness)

map-corner.use: Minimap corner bracket (top-left; mirror with scaleX/scaleY for the other three)

map-strip.use: Status strip plate / generic nameplate; slice 0 38 0 38

tab.use: Tab / label plate with one cut corner

divider.use: Divider rail with centre diamond (width-scalable by 3-slice via CSS background-size: 100% 100% for short runs)

card-common.use: Upgrade card frame (common); border-image slice 62 stretch; hollow centre

card-rare.use: Upgrade card frame (rare); border-image slice 62 stretch; hollow centre

card-epic.use: Upgrade card frame (epic); border-image slice 62 stretch; hollow centre

logo-mark.use: KYNTRAZE shard sigil (full colour), sits beside live wordmark text

logo-mono.use: Mono white shard silhouette (use as CSS mask-image, tint with currentColor)

tex-panel.use: Seamless dark gunmetal tile 256px (panel / modal background, image-rendering: auto)

tex-plate.use: Seamless raised steel plate tile 256px (inset wells, stat tiles)
